coastal.title: Boat collision at Woodfibre LNG site near Squamish was due to safety gaps, TSB finds
coastal.description: Canada's Transportation Safety Board has found a series of gaps leading to a crash between a tugboat and a workboat in 2024, sinking one of the vessels in the waters near Squamish, B.C.

coastal.title: Jury convicts 2 men of 1st-degree murder in gang-related shooting in Whistler: IHIT
coastal.description: Two men have been convicted of murder charges related to the 2022 double homicide of Meninder Dhaliwal and Satindera Gill in Whistler, according to the Integrated Homicide Investigation Team.

kamloops.title: Woven baskets gifted to Okanagan elder, replacing those lost to wildfire
kamloops.description: A B.C. woman who read an Okanagan Indian Band elder's story of losing treasured items in the Bradley Creek wildfire gifted him four woven baskets, believed to be of Syilx origin, from her home.

kamloops.title: 'It's a disgrace': Naramata residents demand answers after termination of fire chief
kamloops.description: Naramata, B.C., residents have launched a petition calling on the Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen to change the culture and improve the dynamics with local fire services, following the abrupt firing of fire chief Dennis Smith in July.

prince-george.title: Fundraisers hit $3M target in push for public MRI in Dawson Creek, B.C.
prince-george.description: The Dawson Creek and District Hospital Foundation says an MRI machine for the city's new hospital will be the first publicly-funded MRI in B.C.'s South Peace region, where patients travel long distances and face long waitlists for diagnostic services.
